name: Hinose Takeru
source:
"It's beyond your grasp. 'Demons' appear suddenly, driven by whims."

A man who was invited to the castle.
He speaks politely to others regardless of their age to set boundaries.
When he gets excited, he tends to insult others and laugh about it.
Contrary to his dainty appearance, he is difficult to approach.
